results.name: Manifestation-gated repeated-evidence causal module
results.hypothesis: Repeated-evidence top-three module predictions improve after excluding drugs whose SIDER side effects are explicit SemMedDB manifestations of the disease.
results.body: R264 excluding side-effect nodes that are manifestations of the candidate disease
results.mechanism_rationale: The veto uses a disease-specific adverse path rather than generic phenotype overlap, but manifestation assertions may encode symptoms common to treated disease.
results.trapi_notes: The positive and adverse paths are TRAPI-expressible; pair-level negation, evidence aggregation, source interpretation, rank, and cardinality require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[binding:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->
      (gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND coalesce(
        effect.evidence_count,
        size(coalesce(effect.publications, [])),
        1
      ) >= 2


WITH subject, object, count(DISTINCT gene) AS targeted_genes
WHERE targeted_genes >= 2
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(:NamedThing)
          -[:MANIFESTATION_OF]->(object)
  }

RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.body: R268 excluding side-effect nodes that are manifestations of the candidate disease
results.mechanism_rationale: Independent target binding and disease-specific adverse evidence are combined, but the negative path remains literature-mined.
